description: Latest Benzinga financial news (the public JSON feed behind benzinga.com): headline, teaser, author, time, URL, tickers, channels and tags. Filter by stock tickers (e.g. AAPL,TSLA) and/or words in the headline/teaser. Newest first, up to 100 stories; no paging into older news, no full article text. Public, no key. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

q.description: Words that must all appear in the headline or teaser (optional, max 200 characters)

tickers.description: Comma-separated stock tickers, up to 10 (optional), e.g. AAPL,TSLA

name: search_benzinga
title: Search Benzinga
